name: Python 3 (Slim Bookworm)
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get upgrade -y && sudo xargs -r apt-get install -y <packages.txt || echo 'No packages.txt or packages failed to install.'; pip3 install --user --upgrade pip setuptools wheel; [ -f requirements.txt ] && pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; pip3 install --user streamlit; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
